hints.title: Tree Path Union Property
hints.text: In a weighted tree, the minimum connected subtree spanning three vertices is the union of their pairwise paths.

hints.title: Pairwise Distance Division
hints.text: Every edge in the spanning subtree is covered exactly twice in the perimeter sum dist(u, v) + dist(v, w) + dist(u, w).

hints.title: Binary Lifting Distance
hints.text: Precompute depths and binary lifting ancestor tables to evaluate tree path distances in O(log n) time per query.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary lifting enables O(log n) LCA queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running individual path searches for each query takes O(n * q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n log n) sparse tables allow answering queries in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the tree Steiner minimal tree perimeter identity and implement binary lifting.
